decision_rationale: TABULA is presented as a new foundation model for single-cell transcriptomics, not a review, benchmark, or wrapper. The evidence describes a cell-by-gene matrix model with gene reconstruction and cell contrastive learning, but no substantive natural-language text component or text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: "directly models the cell-by-gene expression matrix"; "column-wise gene reconstruction and row-wise cell contrastive learning"; "converting gene expression within a single cell to gene sequences to mimic word sequences used in NLP"
